title: MT.INFO.-----C.CONT.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(CW)-31. The prose above identifies the structural target about bebop's meta-reality transcending regionalism. The crossing diagrams how meta-information structurally meets composite-continuance: MT-INFO crossed with C-CONT. MT-INFO sits at left with the subject-arrow; C-CONT at center-bottom as partner-axis. EXT-DY (extended dynamics) upper-center, POL-CONT (political continuance) upper-right. POST (postulation) left. POL-P (political particulars), TR (transformation), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) center-to-right. APT-DY (apt dynamics), AFI (affinity insight), TRS (transformation), (R)INTR (reality of introduction) lower chain.
